**Summary**

Implemented the osq server's forwarded-command and change-folder-file endpoints:

- **`src/core/web/web-remote.ts`** (246 lines) — the `ForwardedCommand`/`ForwardedOutput`/`ForwardedEnd` ports, `ForwardedCommandRunner`, `isRemotePath`, and `createRemoteRoutes`. The `api/commands` endpoint issues its own `createActionToken` token under the read guard, runs a forwarded command behind the write guard, and streams NDJSON (`emit` lines then the `{exitCode,error,next}` result line) with the required headers, converting a runner rejection into `{"exitCode":1,"error":"Error: …","next":null}`.
- **`src/core/web/web-remote-files.ts`** (249 lines) — `resolveRemoteChange` (via `findChange` + first `changeTrees` tree + no `.run/approved`), `readChangeFiles`, `replaceChangeFiles`, path/body validation, and the guarded `GET`/`PUT` handlers. Uploads validate every path and the change before any removal/write, keep `.run/` byte-identical, leave no empty folders, and serialize behind one upload gate.
- **`src/core/web/web-server.ts`** (248 lines) — `runCommand` option and a hand-off to the remote routes for site-relative `/api/commands` and `/api/files/…` before the actions/method rules; unchanged otherwise.
- **`tests/web-remote-commands.test.ts`** and **`tests/web-remote-files.test.ts`** — real port-0 servers, raw `http.request`s for Host/Origin/Content-Type/token, exact NDJSON assertions, all upload-refusal rows, and byte-equality checks after each refusal.

Both the task verify and `pnpm verify` pass; all existing `serve*`, `web*`, and `hosts-*` tests plus the structural budgets pass unchanged. Result written to `openspec/changes/162-remote-cli/.run/results/1.md`.

Task complete. Summary of what I did:

## Source changes
- **`src/core/web/web-remote.ts`** (new, 249 lines): exports the `ForwardedCommand`, `ForwardedOutput`, `ForwardedEnd`, and `ForwardedCommandRunner` ports plus `createRemoteRoutes`. It reuses `createActionToken`, `isHostAllowed`, `isOriginAllowed`, `isJsonMediaType`, `tokenMatches`, `readRequestBody`, `createWriteGate` from `web-write.ts` and `sendJson`/`decodeChangeSelector` from `web-http.ts`. It streams `GET`/`POST api/commands` as `application/x-ndjson` and routes `GET`/`PUT api/files/<id>` to the files module.
- **`src/core/web/web-remote-files.ts`** (new): `readChangeFiles`/`replaceChangeFiles`. Resolves with `findChange`, requires the first `changeTrees` tree and no `.run/approved`, validates every uploaded path, and replaces the folder while preserving `.run/`.
- **`src/core/web/web-server.ts`**: added `runCommand?: ForwardedCommandRunner` and dispatched site-relative `/api/commands` and `/api/files/` requests to the remote routes before actions and method rules. Stays at 250 lines.

## Tests
- **`tests/web-remote-commands.test.ts`** and **`tests/web-remote-files.test.ts`**: 16 tests over real servers on port 0, covering every delta scenario, runner rejection, 404/unsafe-selector/invalid-body cases, all six upload-refusal path rows with byte-equal project snapshots, and the one-upload-at-a-time gate.

## Verification
- Task verify: 16/16 pass.
- Proposal verify (`pnpm verify`): typecheck, UI build, full test suite, and lint all pass.
- Structural tests (line/function budget, no-skipped, change-locations readers, cli-no-exit-code) pass.

Only deviation noted in the result: `startWebServer` has no new `@scenario`/`@adr` tag because `web-server.ts` is exactly at the 250-line budget. The result file is written to `openspec/changes/162-remote-cli/.run/results/1.md`.
